Label: Occupational Health And Safety
Definition: A manufacturer in this category operates a formal occupational health and safety management system to prevent injuries, reduce risk, and continually improve worker safety performance.

Label: ISO 45001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 45001, operating a risk-based OH&S management system with documented controls, training, incident investigation, and continual improvement.

Label: OHSAS 18001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows legacy OHSAS 18001 OH&S requirements (now superseded by ISO 45001) to manage workplace hazards and safety programs.

Label: Professional
Definition: A manufacturer in this category staffs certified professionals and applies documented, standards-based methods and ethics in its engineering/production practices.

Label: AWS Welder
Definition: A manufacturer in this category employs AWS-certified welders and welding procedures validated to American Welding Society codes for quality and safety.

Label: Quality
Definition: A manufacturer in this category runs a documented quality management system with process controls, inspections, nonconformance handling, and corrective/preventive actions.

Label: ASME
Definition: A manufacturer in this category designs and builds to ASME codes (e.g., BPVC/B31), with qualified materials, procedures, and inspections for pressure-boundary equipment.

Label: Aerospace Quality
Definition: A manufacturer in this category applies aerospace-grade quality requirements across design, production, and traceability for aviation/space/defense customers.

Label: AS 9000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows AS 9000—aerospace QMS requirements based on ISO 9001—covering documentation, control of processes, and inspection.

Label: AS 9003
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows AS 9003, an aerospace inspection-and-test quality system emphasizing verification of product conformance for limited/specific scopes.

Label: AS 9100
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to AS 9100, the aerospace QMS that extends ISO 9001 with risk, configuration control, and product safety for aviation/space/defense.

Label: AS 9102
Definition: A manufacturer in this category complies with AS 9102 first-article inspection, documenting initial production results and key characteristics to validate manufacturing processes.

Label: AS 9120
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows AS 9120 requirements focused on quality and traceability for aerospace stockist/distribution activities supporting manufacturing supply chains.

Label: BABA
Definition: A manufacturer in this category attests compliance with Build America, Buy America (BABA) domestic-content rules for federally funded infrastructure, using U.S.-made materials/products.

Label: British Retail Consortium
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to the BRCGS (British Retail Consortium) Food Safety standard, managing hazards, traceability, and hygiene in food production.

Label: FDA
Definition: A manufacturer in this category complies with U.S. FDA requirements applicable to its regulated products (e.g., drugs, devices, foods), including registration, controls, and reporting.

Label: FDA 21 CFR Part 820
Definition: A manufacturer in this category complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation) for medical devices, covering design controls, production, CAPA, and records.

Label: FDA GMP
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows FDA Good Manufacturing Practice requirements to assure identity, strength, quality, and purity of regulated products.

Label: FDA PMA
Definition: A manufacturer in this category has products cleared/approved via FDA Premarket Approval (PMA), demonstrating safety and effectiveness for high-risk medical devices.

Label: GWO
Definition: A manufacturer in this category trains personnel to Global Wind Organisation (GWO) safety/technical standards for wind-industry construction, installation, and O&M work.

Label: HACCP
Definition: A manufacturer in this category operates a HACCP-based food safety system, identifying hazards and controlling critical points in production and packaging.

Label: IATF
Definition: A manufacturer in this category adheres to IATF automotive quality expectations coordinated by the International Automotive Task Force across OEMs and suppliers.

Label: IATF 16949
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to IATF 16949, integrating ISO 9001 with automotive-specific defect prevention, traceability, and process variation control.

Label: ISO Quality
Definition: A manufacturer in this category maintains an ISO-based quality system (typically ISO 9001) with documented processes, audits, and continual improvement.

Label: ISO 13485
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 13485, the medical-device QMS standard emphasizing risk management, sterile controls, and regulatory compliance.

Label: ISO 14000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category aligns to the ISO 14000 family for environmental management, lifecycle impacts, and compliance obligations.

Label: ISO 14001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 14001, running an environmental management system with objectives, controls, and continual improvement.

Label: ISO 16949
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows legacy ISO/TS 16949 automotive quality requirements (predecessor to IATF 16949) for supplier/OEM alignment.

Label: ISO 17265
Definition: A manufacturer in this category complies with the referenced ISO 17265 requirements as provided (product/process-specific standard); scope is applied to relevant materials and tests.

Label: ISO 22000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 22000, managing food safety via HACCP, prerequisite programs, and communication across the food chain.

Label: ISO 27001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO/IEC 27001, operating an information-security management system protecting designs, data, and production systems.

Label: ISO 50001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 50001, operating an energy-management system to improve energy performance, efficiency, and consumption.

Label: ISO 9000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category aligns with ISO 9000 principles (quality fundamentals/terminology) to underpin its documented quality system.

Label: ISO 9001
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to ISO 9001, the general QMS standard covering process control, customer requirements, and continual improvement.

Label: ITAR
Definition: A manufacturer in this category controls exports and technical data per ITAR, managing licensing, access, and record-keeping for defense-related items and services.

Label: Kosher Approved
Definition: A manufacturer in this category holds kosher approval from an authorized agency, ensuring products and processes meet kosher dietary laws and segregation controls.

Label: NADCAP
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is Nadcap-accredited for special processes (e.g., heat treat, coatings, NDT), validated through industry audits for aerospace/defense supply chains.

Label: NIST
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows NIST frameworks/standards (e.g., cybersecurity, measurement) to govern controls, testing, and technology practices.

Label: NIST 800171
Definition: A manufacturer in this category implements NIST SP 800-171 controls to protect Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in non-federal systems supporting contracts.

Label: QS Quality
Definition: A manufacturer in this category adheres to QS automotive quality practices (QS-9000 era), aligning supplier processes with OEM requirements (legacy programs).

Label: QS 9000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category conforms to QS-9000, the legacy Big-Three automotive QMS based on ISO 9001 with sector-specific requirements.

Label: TL Quality
Definition: A manufacturer in this category follows TL telecom quality practices, aligning with sector QMS expectations for carriers and equipment providers.

Label: TL 9000
Definition: A manufacturer in this category is certified to TL 9000, the telecom-sector QMS with metrics and process requirements for network equipment/services.

Label: VDA
Definition: A manufacturer in this category aligns with VDA automotive quality methods (e.g., VDA 6.x, Maturity Level Assurance) used by German OEMs and suppliers.

Label: Sustainability
Definition: A manufacturer in this category runs programs to reduce environmental footprint, conserve resources, and report ESG performance across operations and products.

Label: LEED
Definition: A manufacturer in this category designs/builds or operates facilities to LEED green-building criteria, contributing to certified sustainable buildings and credits.
